typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FilePath as string ('\\ cslnhf501.wellsfargo.com\\DRSProd\\WFSOpsKRIReporting\\DropZone\\Calypso\\LiveTradeStatus'),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Trade Id} as string,
		{Product Type} as string,
		{Currency Pair} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource1	source(output(
		{Trade Id} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> LookupLKPTABLE
FlatFileSource1 derive(FileName = toString((substring(toString($FilePath), toInteger(89), toInteger(120)))),
		FileDate = toString((substring(toString($FilePath), toInteger(104), toInteger(10))))) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive({Copy of FileDate} = toDate(FileDate, "MM/dd/yyyy")) ~> DataConversion1
DataConversion1 split(Currency Pair != '', disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(Case1,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
ConditionalSplit@Case1,LookupLKPTABLE lookup(ConditionalSplit@Case1@{Trade Id} == LookupLKPTABLE@{Trade Id},
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Lookup
Lookup select(mapColumn(
		{Currency Pair} = {Currency Pair},
		{Copy of FileDate} = {Copy of FileDate},
		FileDate = FileDate,
		FileName = FileName,
		{Trade Id} = LookupLKPTABLE@{Trade Id},
		{Product Type} = {Product Type}
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Lookup01
Lookup01 filter(!isMatch()) ~> Lookup0
Lookup0 sink(input(
		FileDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Currency_Pair as string,
		FileName as string,
		Trade_Id as string,
		Product_Type as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		FileDate,
		Currency_Pair = {Currency Pair},
		FileName,
		Trade_Id = {Trade Id},
		Product_Type = {Product Type}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
